title: Sewage sludge

review.classification: UNSD October 2026 CPC3 A1938:D1938 links 39920 to HS 3825.20. Chapter 38 note 5 covers sludge from urban effluent treatment and excludes stabilized sludge suitable for fertilizer. Keep the selected raw external transfer distinct from local primary solids, pharmaceutical or other clinical waste and waste-treatment services. The historic draft addressed a digested cake in a different material state.
review.primary_evidence: Environment Agency permit EPR/NP3601LR (June 2024) distinguishes local from imported material before mixing and identifies 19 08 05 as an accepted waste type. United Utilities original 2024/25 WwTW worksheet D3 labels the reported transport destinations as actual. Glazebury row 63 and Tyldesley row 136 report external road deliveries of raw liquid to Leigh, while row 90 is the co-located site. Receiving-centre STC row 28 reports treated output on a different basis. Annual tonnes dry solids and average solids do not supply the ticket weight, density or composition of a given delivery.
review.measurement: Use the wet net mass of the lot accepted for the first time. Tare, retained heel, free liquid, measured density and representative dry-solids results are distinct evidence. Split source and in-transit ledgers. A rejected receipt and the subsequent physical return do not count as two dispositions. Settle source and loaded-haul burdens to the eligible cohort, retain unsettled and terminal vectors, and segregate empty travel or actual incremental services. No automatic zero burden, fertilizer credit, presumed spill or positive co-product revenue from a treatment fee. The independent check confirmed 1,000 = 600 + 300 + 100 wet kg and 20 = 6 + 12 + 2 t km. B retains 12 t km over its original 300 kg. The 2 t km for C remain terminal. These illustrative quantities are independent of the permit and annual report.
review.native_records: Mass and its group were checked against the archived originals and the author’s copies. The reference unit is kg, with 1 tonne equal to 1,000 kg. Independently fetched four versioned records. The generic Sludge Waste spans several origins, Digested Sludge Product has a different state and Volume basis, the Zhejiang municipal sludge Waste represents dewatered material, and dried sludge is also a different stream. No product, provider-specific source waste, or tanker identity is bound.
review.readiness: The original author commit 116105b6bf8f4f87d9b2204e7375f8a9370a3e5c required a cohort accounting repair. Reviewed final repair 39c389aee3b6edace44bfa4a5fdbb5207b592937 retains the physical scope and corrects both accounting ledgers. The controller expanded the existing section 1 exclusion cross-reference in the two product identity tables so the classification exclusions carry into the structured projection. All three native flow identities remain unresolved, with two verified dimension records. Independent target check performed 18 checks with zero skips and three nonblocking amount-range warnings. Candidate/authored with Chinese aligned. Scientific approval, formal publication and complete study-specific measurements remain pending.
